title: Self-Pass Spin Shooting
description: Without a passer, players spin the ball out in front with backspin, catch it on the bounce in the shooting pocket and shoot, rehearsing the catch-and-shoot alone.

content.objective: Practise catch-and-shoot footwork and the shooting pocket alone, with a realistic catch.
content.setup: Player at any spot facing the rim with a ball.
content.organization: Individual work; several players at different baskets.
instructions: Toss the ball out in front with backspin so it bounces back toward you.
Step into the catch with a hop or a 1-2.
Catch in the shooting pocket and rise into the shot.
Rebound, dribble to a new spot and repeat.
coachingPoints: Backspin brings the ball back into your hands.
Catch with the knees already bent.
Same footwork as a real pass.
commonMistakes: Tossing too far and chasing the ball.
Skipping the footwork and just shooting.
content.safety: Several players per basket shoot in turns, not all at once.
progressions: Spin the ball sideways to practise catches moving left or right.
Add a dribble move after the catch.
variations: Free-throw line pull-up after the self-pass.
Self-pass from under the basket out to the wing.
successCriteria: Ball returns to the hands without chasing on most tosses.
content.gameApplication: A self-pass lets players practise game shots without a partner.
